headline.en: Land Surveying — See the Land as It Truly Is
headline.sw: Upimaji wa Ardhi — Uone Ardhi Kama Ilivyo Kweli

description.en: Our team delivers precise and reliable spatial data using advanced GNSS, Total Stations, and Drone LiDAR technologies — ensuring centimeter-level accuracy on every site. From Nairobi, Kiambu, Kisumu, Mombasa, and across Africa, we map and measure the land with unmatched detail to support informed design and development decisions.
description.sw: Timu yetu hutoa data sahihi na ya kuaminika ya eneo kwa kutumia teknolojia za kisasa za GNSS, Total Stations, na Drone LiDAR — kuhakikisha usahihi wa kiwango cha sentimita kwenye kila tovuti. Kutoka Nairobi, Kiambu, Kisumu, Mombasa, na kote Afrika, tunapima na kuchora ramani za ardhi kwa maelezo yasiyoshindwa kuunga mkono maamuzi ya ubunifu na maendeleo.

description.en: At SmartGrid Surveying, we specialize in Land surveys using aerial drones, RTK Base Rover Stations, and Total Stations to deliver precise and efficient mapping solutions. Our drones capture high-resolution terrain data, while RTK technology ensures real-time positional accuracy. With Total Stations providing precise distance and angle measurements, we guarantee detailed site assessments with minimal errors. This advanced approach enhances efficiency, improves decision-making, and ensures the highest level of accuracy for our clients' surveying needs.
description.sw: Katika SmartGrid Surveying, tunabobea upimaji wa ardhi kwa kutumia droni za hewa, vituo vya RTK Base Rover, na Total Stations kutoa suluhisho za ramani sahihi na zenye ufanisi. Droni zetu hukamata data ya juu ya ardhi, huku RTK ikihakikisha usahihi wa nafuni wa papo hapo. Kwa Total Stations zinazotoa vipimo sahihi ya umbali na pembe, tunahakikisha tathmini za kina za tovuti zenye makosa madogo. Njia hii ya kisasa huongeza ufanisi, kuboresha maamuzi, na kuhakikisha kiwango cha juu zaidi cha usahihi kwa mahitaji ya upimaji ya wateja wetu.

description.en: Conduct a thorough site evaluation and assess flight parameters for drone survey readiness.
description.sw: Fanya tathmini kamili ya tovuti na tathini vigezo vya uruka kwa utayari wa uchunguzi wa droni.

description.en: Place georeferenced ground control points (GCPs) for accurate integration of aerial data.
description.sw: Weka alama za udhibiti wa ardhi (GCPs) zenye jio-rejeleo kwa muunganisho sahihi wa data ya hewa.

description.en: Deploy drone with precise flight paths, capturing high-resolution imagery and topographic data.
description.sw: Tumia droni kwa njia sahihi za uruka, ukikamata picha za ubora wa juu na data ya topografia.

description.en: Process aerial data using photogrammetry software to generate 3D models, orthoimages, and contours.
description.sw: Chakata data ya hewa kwa programu za photogrammetry kutengeneza modeli za 3D, orthoimages, na contours.

description.en: Use total stations and RTK-GNSS systems to validate drone data and ensure the highest accuracy.
description.sw: Tumia total stations na mifumo ya RTK-GNSS kuhakiki data ya droni na kuhakikisha usahihi wa juu zaidi.

description.en: Generate CAD drawings, GIS layers, and digital reports for final project handover and analysis.
description.sw: Tengeneza michoro ya CAD, tabaka za GIS, na ripoti za kidijitali kwa uhandishi wa mwisho wa mradi na uchambuzi.

description.en: Accurate, submission-ready outputs for planning, titling, and engineering decisions.
description.sw: Pato sahihi, tayari kwa kuwasilisha kwa maamuzi ya mipango, hati, na uhandisi.
